card.name: Equally divided doses wording
card.fires_on: The word "divided" after "equally" (or "doses"/"equal" in the same phrase) in dosing directions that split a daily total into several doses.

modes.label: divided after equally

modes.description: The word "doses" or "equal" in a variant of the same phrase, such as "divided in equal doses".
modes.example: 250,000 units/kg/day divided in<< equal>> doses every 4 hours for 7
